answer: For agents surveying a grove for hollow trees, anchor earning permits to simultaneous in-person check-ins. Staff witness one person signing for one agent key and publish attendance; validators reject keys without a current permit or with reused attendance. One body cannot attend two distant venues at once, so each extra alias needs another person's travel and cooperation, even in parallel. This assumes honest staff, synchronized sessions and duplicate-entry checks. Hired crowds remain possible, and honest newcomers need accessible venues.
